session.input: Playwright keyboard traversal and camera taps

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Route surfaces are clearer than v9, but the arena still collapses into dark voids
observations.context: All four v10 player-eye views compared with the same v9 route
observations.action: Traverse from west spawn through the Press Hall and rotate across the Ink Channel and archive tier
observations.expectation: Playable planes, cover edges, material groups, and distant traversal choices remain legible without flattening the industrial mood
observations.actual: The floor, ramp, rails, and cyan route accents are more readable than v9, but large ceiling, wall, machine, and weapon regions still lose surface information against black negative space
observations.playerConsequence: Navigation is improved but enemy spotting, depth estimation, and confidence in collision edges would remain inconsistent during combat
reproduction: Compare v9 and v10 screenshots 01 through 04 at normal viewing size
Inspect the ceiling, brown press shell, and black machinery behind the ramp
hypotheses: Black-steel and shell materials remain too close in value at gameplay distance
Large industrial landmarks need localized fill and authored surface breakup rather than more global exposure
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Brighten only the black-steel structural family and make the press roller body readable, then repeat the identical source-frozen route
observations.recommendedOutcome: Keep the dark foundry atmosphere while preserving clear combat silhouettes and visible machinery bodies

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: The corrected portal is present at the authority side, but the route packet does not make it a clear traversal target
observations.context: Archive-facing view and generated lower/upper portal source renders
observations.action: Look toward Red Fold from the west approach and archive-facing camera
observations.expectation: One grounded frame, active field, entry plane, and destination language read immediately as a usable linked portal
observations.actual: The small framed field is visible in the distance in screenshot 04 and the obsolete red rectangle is gone, but it is visually subordinate to two large orange roller collars that still read as floating rings
observations.playerConsequence: A first-time player could still approach the wrong landmark or fail to identify the portal during a fight
reproduction: Compare the small framed portal near center with the two large orange rings overhead
hypotheses: The press roller body is too dark to visually connect its orange collars
The player-eye route is not close enough to prove portal entry-plane readability
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Reveal the roller body and capture a close frontal portal approach, entry, linked exit, and reconnect sequence
observations.recommendedOutcome: Make the actual portal the only portal-like landmark and prove the full interaction loop from player eye

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Support clutter is reduced, but the Press Hall still reads as scaffold construction
observations.context: Press Hall ramp and Ink Channel side views
observations.action: Inspect the ramp from below and beside its traversal lane
observations.expectation: A few strong load paths, joined beams, and deliberate negative space communicate a finished industrial structure
observations.actual: The redundant donor trusses and half of the procedural support cadence are gone, yet repeated rails, upright posts, exposed feet, ceiling bars, and diagonal braces still compete at similar visual weight
observations.playerConsequence: Target lanes remain noisy and the map still looks assembled from construction primitives instead of authored architectural groups
reproduction: Compare v9 and v10 screenshots 02 and 03
Follow the remaining supports from floor feet through deck and rail
hypotheses: The remaining support language still lacks large authored connection plates and grouped bays
Secondary rails and ceiling members need distance-based hierarchy
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Author one finished bridge bay with fewer thicker members, visible joints, and a clear silhouette, then compare it at 5 m and 20 m
observations.recommendedOutcome: Replace the scaffold rhythm with two or three recognizable structural assemblies and open combat sightlines

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: The placeholder rifle and transitional HUD remain the strongest unfinished signals
observations.action: Read the combat view at normal size
observations.expectation: The accepted gun-pack presentation and one restrained match HUD share a coherent industrial visual language
observations.actual: The rifle remains a large near-black block with minimal mechanical detail; the bottom boxed abilities, oversized health/ammo typography, top score bar, and diagnostic labels still look like separate UI generations
observations.playerConsequence: The two always-visible surfaces make the entire build feel substantially less complete than its authority and networking implementation
reproduction: Inspect the lower-right weapon and all four HUD edges
hypotheses: The accepted gun pack has not yet replaced the online first-person placeholder
HUD implementations from multiple lanes have not been reduced to one typed presentation system
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Bind one accepted rifle with correct hands, muzzle, ADS, and recoil contact, then recapture with the unified HUD candidate
observations.recommendedOutcome: Replace both continuous unfinished signals before requesting owner map/play acceptance

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: Static route evidence still cannot establish combat, portal, animation, or fun quality
observations.action: Attempt to judge opponent readability, locomotion, weapon contact, ability VFX/audio, portal travel, and encounter flow
observations.expectation: An acceptance packet covers the complete play loop with representative opponents, actions, transitions, and sound
observations.actual: The packet proves a source-frozen hardware route and correct authority identity, but contains no close portal traversal, enemy animation, combat exchange, weapon animation, audio, or sustained player decision loop
observations.playerConsequence: Human map/play acceptance and the broader vertical-slice verdict remain unearned
reproduction: Review all v10 screenshots and focused-visual-capture.json
Look for interaction and time-based proof beyond camera movement
hypotheses: This capture was intentionally scoped to visual continuity rather than whole-game acceptance
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Record a bounded real-play sequence covering spawn, movement, combat, all equipped abilities, portal traversal, death, respawn, and reconnect
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use that sequence for owner review only after the rifle, HUD, map landmarks, and opponent presentation are integrated
